```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

nsti <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "picrust2", "picrust_output_abundance01", "marker_predicted_and_nsti.tsv.gz")
)

colnames(nsti)
```
```{r}
summary(
  nsti$metadata_NSTI
)

quantile(
  nsti$metadata_NSTI,
  probs = c(
    0,
    0.25,
    0.50,
    0.75,
    0.90,
    0.95,
    0.99,
    1
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ggplot(
  nsti,
  aes(x = metadata_NSTI)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 50
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0.15,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "NSTI",
    y = "Number of ASVs"
  )
```

```{r}
cutoffs <- c(
  0.10,
  0.15,
  0.20,
  0.50,
  2.00
)

data.frame(
  cutoff = cutoffs,
  n_retained = sapply(
    cutoffs,
    function(x) {
      sum(
        nsti$metadata_NSTI <= x,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
  ),
  proportion_retained = sapply(
    cutoffs,
    function(x) {
      mean(
        nsti$metadata_NSTI <= x,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Helper: extract sample x feature matrix from phyloseq
# ============================================================

phyloseq_to_maaslin <- function(ps) {

  x <- as(
    otu_table(ps),
    "matrix"
  )

  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
    x <- t(x)
  }

  x <- as.data.frame(
    x,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  return(x)
}
```


```{r}
## Load phyloseq object
ps_f <- readRDS(file = here("data", "phyloseq", "ps_healthy_filtered_082626.rds"))

input_data <- phyloseq_to_maaslin(ps_f)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================
# NSTI table
# ============================================================

nsti_df <- nsti %>%
  select(
    sequence,
    metadata_NSTI
  )

# ============================================================
# Make sure ASV IDs are available as a column
# ============================================================

asv_df <- as.data.frame(read.table(here("../data/picrust2/picrust2_input/feature_table.tsv"), header = TRUE, row.names = 1))

asv_df$sequence <- rownames(
  asv_df
)

# ============================================================
# Add NSTI
# ============================================================

asv_nsti <- asv_df %>%
  inner_join(
    nsti_df,
    by = "sequence"
  )

# ============================================================
# Convert to long format
# ============================================================

asv_nsti_long <- asv_nsti %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(
      sequence,
      metadata_NSTI
    ),
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "count"
  )

# ============================================================
# NSTI cutoffs
# ============================================================

cutoffs <- c(
  0.10,
  0.15,
  0.20,
  0.50,
  2.00
)

# ============================================================
# Fraction of abundance retained in every sample
# ============================================================

abundance_retention <- lapply(
  cutoffs,
  function(cur_cutoff) {

    asv_nsti_long %>%
      group_by(sample) %>%
      summarise(
        total_abundance = sum(
          count,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        retained_abundance = sum(
          count[
            metadata_NSTI <= cur_cutoff
          ],
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        proportion_retained =
          retained_abundance /
          total_abundance,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        cutoff = cur_cutoff
      )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
abundance_retention %>%
  group_by(cutoff) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_retained = mean(
      proportion_retained,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_retained = median(
      proportion_retained,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    min_retained = min(
      proportion_retained,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    q05_retained = quantile(
      proportion_retained,
      0.05,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  abundance_retention,
  aes(
    x = factor(cutoff),
    y = proportion_retained
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Maximum NSTI",
    y = "Proportion of sample abundance retained"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

ggsave(file.path(here("data/manuscript/supp_figs"), "FigS1_NSTIplot.png"), plot = last_plot(), dpi = 600, 
       width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", limitsize = FALSE)
```

# Check NSTI for microbes of interest
```{r}
picrust_dir <- here("data", "picrust2", "picrust_output_css_all")

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

nsti_file <- file.path(
  picrust_dir,
  "marker_predicted_and_nsti.tsv.gz"
)

nsti <- read_tsv(
  nsti_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

colnames(nsti)
head(nsti)

asvs_of_interest <- c(
  "ASV33",
  "ASV87",
  "ASV111",
  "ASV166"
)

nsti_selected <- nsti %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    sequence %in% asvs_of_interest
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sequence,
    metadata_NSTI
  )

nsti_selected
```
